Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's gradebook says zero. Why am I finding that out from a phone?

That's what your own procedure says, and I want it in writing. But it doesn't tell me why the zero went in before anyone called me. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, and you named that, but you never earned it with evidence, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You told her the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, which met her fallback demand, but with no evidence behind it she did not move a position.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing anything, so she heard it as asking her to admit something, and you never explained why the zero went in before anyone called her.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence, so you never came close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
